short_description:
Where to find the Backrooms easter egg in GTA 6: a small dig site on the east shore of Lake Tallaloko, north of Millport (Lummox County). Find the open orange shipping container, walk in and use the item on the table at the back. Guides disagree on what the item is, and the reward isn't confirmed yet. No story spoilers.

Sources: GAMES.GG, Xbox Play, Final Boss, GTA6 Track, Hold to Reset, Game Rant, Sportskeeda.

Every spot is pinned on our interactive map at vicereplay.com (Guides).

Busca el contenedor naranja abierto, entra y usa el objeto de la mesa del fondo. Fuentes: GAMES.GG, Xbox Play, Final Boss, GTA6 Track, Game Rant, Sportskeeda.

facts_note: Nov 26 research (map-finds agent + own search): location agreed by 5+ guides (dig/construction site, east or southeast shore of Lake Tallaloko, north of Millport; open orange container). NOT said on screen: the item (guides disagree: takeout box / small item / pill), the reward (stamina + tattoo: one guide) and the unlock time (unconfirmed). 'Lake Tallaloko' is printed on Rockstar's map (pin nudged to the east shore). Read from search summaries: re-check right before upload.
